# Hat of Disguise (`magic-items:hat-of-disguise`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing this hat, you can cast the Disguise Self spell. The spell ends if the hat is removed.
